_comment: Universal Core Stratagem citations (the four from the 10e core rules page on Wahapedia, applicable to every army) plus detachment-specific entries for Cult of Magic (Thousand Sons), Plague Company (Death Guard), and Battle Host (Aeldari). Additional detachments (Awakened Dynasty, Astartes, etc.) wire their stratagems in a follow-up task.

Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN YOU MAKE A HIT ROLL, A WOUND ROLL, A DAMAGE ROLL, A SAVING THROW, AN ADVANCE ROLL, A CHARGE ROLL, A BATTLE-SHOCK TEST OR A CONTROL TEST FOR YOU OR A FRIENDLY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY: That roll is re-rolled. If a Charge roll, Advance roll, control test or Battle-shock test is being re-rolled, both of the dice are re-rolled.
Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.trigger: any phase, when a friendly unit makes a Hit/Wound/Damage/Save/Advance/Charge/Battle-shock/control roll
Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.effect: re-roll the failed roll (simulator currently exposes this only on a failed wound roll vs a HEAVY/SHOOTY/DUAL target — highest-value trigger, others covered by detachment re-roll passives)

Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN THE FIGHT PHASE, JUST AFTER AN ENEMY UNIT HAS FOUGHT. ONE FRIENDLY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT IS WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF ONE OR MORE ENEMY UNITS CAN BE SELECTED TO FIGHT NEXT, EVEN IF IT HAS ALREADY FOUGHT THIS PHASE.
Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.trigger: fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has fought
Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.effect: a friendly unit in engagement range fights out-of-sequence — strikes the enemy that just fought before activation continues (simulator gates the heuristic on the enemy having killed a model so we spend the 2 CP on real swings, not free retaliations)

Stratagem.Tank Shock.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN THE CHARGE PHASE, WHEN A VEHICLE UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY ENDS A CHARGE MOVE. SELECT ONE ENEMY UNIT THAT IS WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF THAT VEHICLE UNIT AND ROLL ONE D6, ADDING THE TOUGHNESS CHARACTERISTIC OF ONE MODEL FROM THAT VEHICLE UNIT TO THE RESULT: ON A 7+, THE ENEMY UNIT TAKES D3 MORTAL WOUNDS (TO A MAXIMUM OF 6 MORTAL WOUNDS).
Stratagem.Tank Shock.trigger: charge phase, when a friendly VEHICLE unit ends a charge move
Stratagem.Tank Shock.effect: the target enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds (approximation: simulator skips the d6+T 7+ gate and applies median D3 = 2 mortal wounds deterministically; matches our other 'median D3' uses such as Reanimation Protocols)

Stratagem.Heroic Intervention.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR OPPONENT'S CHARGE PHASE, JUST AFTER AN ENEMY UNIT ENDS A CHARGE MOVE. ONE FRIENDLY CHARACTERS UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT IS WITHIN 6" OF THAT ENEMY UNIT AND WOULD BE ELIGIBLE TO DECLARE A CHARGE AGAINST IT IN YOUR NEXT CHARGE PHASE CAN PERFORM A HEROIC INTERVENTION. IF IT DOES, THAT FRIENDLY CHARACTERS UNIT CAN MAKE A NORMAL MOVE OF UP TO 3", BUT IT MUST END THAT MOVE IN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF THAT ENEMY UNIT.
Stratagem.Heroic Intervention.trigger: opponent's charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a charge move within 6" of a friendly CHARACTER unit
Stratagem.Heroic Intervention.effect: the friendly CHARACTER unit makes a free 3" move and must end in engagement range of the charger (approximation: simulator aims the move 1" short of the charger to land in melee; doesn't enforce the 'eligible to charge next phase' clause)

Stratagem.Doombolt.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE. ONE THOUSAND SONS PSYKER UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY CAN UNLEASH THE POWER OF DOOMBOLT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, ONE WEAPON IT IS EQUIPPED WITH HAS THE [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ABILITY AND IMPROVES ITS WEAPON STRENGTH AND ARMOUR PENETRATION CHARACTERISTICS BY 1.
Stratagem.Doombolt.trigger: shooting phase, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is about to make ranged attacks
Stratagem.Doombolt.effect: approximation: simulator skips the weapon-stat tweaks and instead deals 2 mortal wounds (median D3) to the highest-threat enemy unit each round the stratagem fires — captures the per-Shooting-Phase 'crack off a Doombolt' cadence that was previously hard-wired as the made-up `psychic_mortal_wounds_per_round` field

Stratagem.Twist of Fate.rule_name: Twist of Fate (Cult of Magic Stratagem)
Stratagem.Twist of Fate.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN A THOUSAND SONS UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO SHOOT OR FIGHT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME A MODEL IN THAT UNIT MAKES AN ATTACK, ADD 1 TO THE WOUND ROLL.
Stratagem.Twist of Fate.trigger: shooting or fight phase, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS unit is selected to shoot or fight
Stratagem.Twist of Fate.effect: approximation: simulator grants the unit a transient +1 to wound on attacks for the round (real rule is single-phase; we apply for the whole round to keep the stratagem dispatcher uniform with the others). Modeled as the unit's `transient_plus_one_to_wound_shooting` flag, applied at start of round when the AI greenlights the spend

Stratagem.Glamour of Tzeentch.rule_name: Glamour of Tzeentch (Cult of Magic Stratagem)
Stratagem.Glamour of Tzeentch.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN A THOUSAND SONS UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED AS THE TARGET OF AN ATTACK. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, MODELS IN YOUR UNIT HAVE THE BENEFIT OF COVER AND EACH TIME A RANGED ATTACK TARGETS YOUR UNIT, SUBTRACT 1 FROM THE HIT ROLL.
Stratagem.Glamour of Tzeentch.trigger: any phase, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS unit is the target of an attack
Stratagem.Glamour of Tzeentch.effect: approximation: simulator grants the unit a transient 4+ invuln for the round (real rule layers cover + -1 to hit; we collapse to a 4++ as the equivalent defensive uplift, since our Unit.attack already routes both effects through save/invuln). Modeled as `transient_invuln_4` flag

Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN A DEATH GUARD UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED AS THE TARGET OF AN ATTACK. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME AN ATTACK IS ALLOCATED TO A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT, SUBTRACT 1 FROM THE DAMAGE CHARACTERISTIC OF THAT ATTACK (TO A MINIMUM OF 1).
Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.trigger: any phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is the target of an attack
Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.effect: the unit's `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` flag is set; for the round each incoming attack has its per-shot damage reduced by 1 (floor 1). Fires at start of round on a wounded DG unit when the AI greenlights the spend

Stratagem.Plague Weapons.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE OR THE FIGHT PHASE, WHEN A DEATH GUARD UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO SHOOT OR FIGHT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT MAKES AN ATTACK WITH A PLAGUE WEAPON, ADD 1 TO THE WOUND ROLL.
Stratagem.Plague Weapons.trigger: shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is selected to shoot
Stratagem.Plague Weapons.effect: the attacker's `transient_plus_one_to_wound_shooting` flag is set; for the round its ranged attacks gain +1 to the wound roll (real rule is Plague-Weapon-keyword-gated; we approximate by applying to all ranged attacks since BSData doesn't tag individual weapons as Plague). Effect kept distinct from Outbreak of Pestilence by splitting it shooting-only vs melee-only

Stratagem.Outbreak of Pestilence.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN THE FIGHT PHASE, WHEN A DEATH GUARD UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO FIGHT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, MELEE WEAPONS EQUIPPED BY MODELS IN YOUR UNIT HAVE THE [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+] ABILITY.
Stratagem.Outbreak of Pestilence.trigger: fight phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is selected to fight
Stratagem.Outbreak of Pestilence.effect: approximation: simulator grants the unit a transient +1 to wound on melee attacks for the round (rather than implementing a one-shot Anti-INFANTRY 4+ via the existing anti_keywords machinery, since the stratagem's payload is round-scoped and the anti_keywords tuple is profile-immutable). Modeled as `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` flag

Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN AN AELDARI UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED AS THE TARGET OF AN ATTACK. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT MAKES A SAVING THROW, ADD 1 TO THE ROLL.
Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.trigger: any phase, when a friendly AELDARI unit is the target of an attack
Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.effect: the unit's `transient_plus_one_save` flag is set; Unit.attack reads the flag when computing save_after_ap and lowers the save target by 1 (capped at 2+). Fires at start of round on a vulnerable Aeldari unit when AI greenlights the spend

Stratagem.Fire and Fade.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE, AFTER AN AELDARI UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY HAS SHOT. THAT UNIT CAN MAKE A NORMAL MOVE OF UP TO 6". IT CANNOT END THAT MOVE WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF ANY ENEMY UNITS.
Stratagem.Fire and Fade.trigger: shooting phase, after a friendly AELDARI unit has shot
Stratagem.Fire and Fade.effect: approximation: a grid-free sim can't usefully model post-shoot 6" repositioning (the unit can't break LoS in a way our LoS model would notice), so we route the offensive value through a re-roll natural-1s-to-hit on the shoot itself. Originally we routed it as re-roll ANY failed hit but that over-buffed Aeldari by +5 pts vs the meta target — the 1s-only re-roll is a third the strength and lands closer to the real stratagem's mobility upside. The unit's `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` flag is set when fired at start of round

Stratagem.Matchless Agility.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR MOVEMENT PHASE, WHEN AN AELDARI UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO MAKE AN ADVANCE MOVE. DO NOT MAKE AN ADVANCE ROLL FOR THAT UNIT. INSTEAD, UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, ADD 6" TO THE MOVE CHARACTERISTIC OF MODELS IN THAT UNIT.
Stratagem.Matchless Agility.trigger: movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI unit is selected to make an Advance move
Stratagem.Matchless Agility.effect: the unit's `transient_assault_this_round` flag is set; the move sub-phase treats the unit as having Assault weapons for the round (advance and still shoot) and the Heavy-keyword movement penalty is short-circuited. Fires at start of round when AI greenlights spend on an Aeldari shooter not already in range

Stratagem.Implacable Onslaught.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM AT THE END OF YOUR OPPONENT'S CHARGE PHASE. ONE NECRONS UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT WAS THE TARGET OF A CHARGE THIS PHASE HAS THE FEEL NO PAIN 5+ ABILITY UNTIL THE START OF YOUR NEXT TURN.
Stratagem.Implacable Onslaught.trigger: end of opponent's charge phase, on a NECRONS unit (real rule: that was the target of a charge; the simulator widens the trigger to 'any vulnerable Necron unit' since we don't track per-unit charge-target state across the round)
Stratagem.Implacable Onslaught.effect: the unit's `transient_fnp_5` flag is set; receive_damage takes the min of (profile.fnp, bonus_fnp, 5) so the FNP 5+ composes with any pre-existing FNP value. Cleared at the start of the next round, matching the codex 'until the start of your next turn' duration

Stratagem.Methodical Destruction.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE, WHEN A NECRONS UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO SHOOT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT MAKES AN ATTACK THAT TARGETS AN ENEMY UNIT THAT HAS HAD ANY OF ITS MODELS DESTROYED BY ANOTHER FRIENDLY NECRONS UNIT THIS PHASE, RE-ROLL THE HIT ROLL AND RE-ROLL THE WOUND ROLL.
Stratagem.Methodical Destruction.trigger: shooting phase, when a friendly NECRONS unit shoots at an enemy already damaged by friendly Necrons fire this phase
Stratagem.Methodical Destruction.effect: approximation: the simulator doesn't track 'damaged this phase by a Necron unit' state, so we collapse the rule into a flat +1 to hit on the selected Necron shooter's ranged attacks for the round (lowers hit_target by 1, min 2, capped by the 10e modifier cap). Captures the intended 'pour fire into a priority target' identity without the per-target bookkeeping the codex assumes

Stratagem.Cabbalistic Empowerment.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE, WHEN A THOUSAND SONS PSYKER UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO SHOOT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT MAKES AN ATTACK WITH A WITCHFIRE OR PSYCHIC WEAPON, ADD 1 TO THE WOUND ROLL.
Stratagem.Cabbalistic Empowerment.trigger: shooting phase, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is selected to shoot a psychic weapon
Stratagem.Cabbalistic Empowerment.effect: approximation: the simulator's Cult of Magic Doombolt is the only psychic-weapon path that exposes mortal-wound damage, so Cabbalistic Empowerment is collapsed into 'boost the round's Doombolt payload by +1 MW' (from median-D3 2 to 3) when the stratagem fires. The army-level flag `cabbalistic_doombolt_boost` carries the buff for the round and is reset at start-of-round. Composes with the existing Doombolt dispatcher

Stratagem.Spirit Stones.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN AN AELDARI UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED AS THE TARGET OF AN ATTACK. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, EACH TIME AN ATTACK IS ALLOCATED TO A MODEL IN YOUR UNIT, HALVE THE DAMAGE CHARACTERISTIC OF THAT ATTACK (ROUNDING UP).
Stratagem.Spirit Stones.trigger: any phase, when a friendly AELDARI unit is the target of an attack
Stratagem.Spirit Stones.effect: the unit's `transient_halve_damage` flag is set; receive_damage halves the per-call damage characteristic (math.ceil(amount / 2)) before applying FNP. Composes with the Disgustingly Resilient `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` flag by stacking after the -1 (the codex order is unspecified; we apply -1 first because it's already in place from existing Plague Company plumbing). Cited as Saim-Hann but attached to the Battle Host detachment since the simulator carries one Aeldari detachment

Stratagem.Strike Swiftly.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR MOVEMENT PHASE, WHEN A T'AU EMPIRE UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO MAKE AN ADVANCE MOVE. UNTIL THE END OF YOUR TURN, WEAPONS EQUIPPED BY MODELS IN YOUR UNIT HAVE THE [ASSAULT] ABILITY.
Stratagem.Strike Swiftly.trigger: movement phase, when a friendly T'AU EMPIRE unit is selected to make an Advance move
Stratagem.Strike Swiftly.effect: the unit's `transient_assault_this_round` flag is set; _do_shoot's Advanced-this-round gate short-circuits when the flag is True so the unit can shoot in the same round it advanced. Same mechanic as the Aeldari Battle Host Matchless Agility stratagem; both share the underlying flag. Fires at start of round on a T'au shooter currently out of weapon range
